title: Discovering George Lewis at Preservation Hall, 1962
summary: Green wanders past Preservation Hall and recognises George Lewis, whom he had last heard in 1946.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yes, I think it was January 62. I had been in Washington and just decided to go with the government. Had a few days, came down here, uh, and was wandering on the street and past Preservation Hall, which I had not even heard of up until that date. And, uh, was with a friend, and I said, my God, that sounds like George Lewis. And I sort of blindly pushed in past Sandy, past the basket, didn't stop, opened the door, and I said, my God, it is George Lewis. And, uh, I hadn't heard him play since, I think it was 1946 when he was in New York at the Starbizzen Casino with Funk, which in itself was a startling experience, walking in and suddenly hearing this sound. And all you knew prior to that time were the Condon records and Wild Bill Davidson and those big clothes.
